column1: Fig. 3. Temporal variations in microbial enzyme activities in *Pinus halepensis* litters measured after 2 (June), 5 (September), and 13 (May) months in litterbags. Litterbags C10/C10 (black) and C10/C300 (white) are litters from area C10 placed in area C10 or C300, respectively. Litterbags C300/C300 (gray) and C300/C10 (dash) are litters from area C300 placed in area C300 or C10, respectively. The different letters show significant differences of means according to Kruskal-Wallis non-parametric comparison (p < 0.05) between the litterbags tested separately for each sampling time (n = 12). Error bars are SE (n = 3). At t0 enzyme activities (U gdw$^{-1}$) in C10 and C300 were respectively: laccase activity 0.5 (±1), 1.4 (±0.5), cellulase activity 1.6 (±0.3), 3.2 (±0.5), phosphatase activity 0.8 (±0.1), 0.7 (±0.1), and β-glucosidase activity 0.6 (±0.1), 0.6 (±0.0).
